Readiness is separate from booking, transport, and administrative signoff. C's afternoon transport aligns with the afternoon room availability; no booking completion is recorded.","evidence":"Adopted v2 (R08) supersedes v1: the same station must have firmware 8, packet success ≥99%, latency ≤7 seconds, buffering enabled, and runtime ≥8 hours; equality passes. C meets every requirement: 198/200 packets, 7 seconds, buffering enabled, 8 hours (R10–R12). B has firmware 8, 119/120 packets (99.17%), 6 seconds, buffering enabled, but only 7.5 hours. Its replacement pack remains unreceived and unmeasured (R04, R09, R12). A has firmware 8 and reusable 9-hour runtime, but its only packet/latency tests were on firmware 7 and became invalid after upgrading (R03, R06). Its green READY badge is historical v1 evidence, not current approval. Invalidation does not prove deterioration.","next":"Use C for current technical eligibility before choosing logistics. B would qualify after an installed replacement pack verifies ≥8 hours, with other qualifying attributes unchanged. Enabling A's buffering alone is insufficient: obtain qualifying firmware-8 packet and latency tests. Consult R01/R08 for evidence reuse and firmware-change rules; R12 confirms no later changes."}
